evidencia.recomendacoes: Users are advised to read the PRISMA 2020 statement paper in conjunction with the explanation and elaboration paper, which provides exemplars of good reporting and explanations to enhance the use, understanding and dissemination of PRISMA 2020.

resumo: PRISMA 2020 consists of a statement paper, which includes a description of how the reporting guideline was developed and presents a checklist of items and sub-items, an expanded checklist that details reporting recommendations for each item/sub-item, an abstract checklist, and template flow diagrams for original and updated reviews.
